decision: Deletion of lap time (1:13.890) as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
event_name: Date 27 July 2019 Time 13:54 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 7 did not use the track at all times, at turn 17.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Ch IV, Art 2c and Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Deletion of lap time (1:13.890) as per Article 31.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and received timing information from the Race Director. The car left the track during practice 3. This was reviewed in accordance with the Race Director's event notes, point 9.
